summary: Tested 3 new features: FAQ Layout Variants (custom size, duplicate, model binding), Calculator Certificate Discount (18% compound), and PDF discount display. All backend tests passed (10/10). Frontend tests confirmed all features working correctly.

minor.issue: Font error 'dejavusans' in test environment - pre-existing issue, not related to new features

context_for_next_testing_agent: Three features fully implemented and tested: 1) FAQ Layout Variants now support custom sizes (input with placeholder 'Например: 2m, 3.5m, 7m'), duplicate button on each variant card (title='Дублировать планировку'), and model binding via checkboxes. 2) Calculator has certificate discount button (data-testid='certificate-discount-btn') that applies 18% compound discount. 3) PDF discount section shows only price before/after and savings, no percentage.

features_tested.layout_variants_grouped: PASS - GET /api/faq/layout-variants/grouped returns grouped variants sorted numerically
features_tested.layout_variants_duplicate_api: PASS - POST /api/faq/layout-variants/{id}/duplicate creates copy with '(копия)' suffix
features_tested.layout_variants_custom_size: PASS - Can create variant with arbitrary size like '7.5m'
features_tested.certificate_discount_button: PASS - Button visible with data-testid='certificate-discount-btn', text 'Płatność certyfikatem (-18%)'
features_tested.certificate_discount_toggle: PASS - Button toggles ON/OFF, turns blue when active
features_tested.certificate_discount_order: PASS - Orders can store certificateDiscount field
features_tested.pdf_discount_no_percentage: PASS - PDF discount section shows 'Cena przed rabatem', 'Cena po rabacie', 'Oszczędzasz' - no 'Rabat: X%'
features_tested.frontend_duplicate_button: PASS - Duplicate button visible on variant cards with title 'Дублировать планировку'
features_tested.frontend_duplicate_action: PASS - Clicking duplicate creates new variant, shows success toast 'Планировка дублирована'
features_tested.frontend_custom_size_input: PASS - Add layout dialog has size input with placeholder 'Например: 2m, 3.5m, 7m'
features_tested.frontend_model_binding: PASS - Add layout dialog has checkboxes to bind layout to specific model variants
